title: The Canon of the Fettered Seal
summary: A canon that fuses sealing with binding so the seal holds the foe fast and the fetter closes the seal on every side.

title: Manual of the Warded Seal
summary: A manual that fuses sealing with protection so the ward guards the user and the seal on the same ward holds the foe.

title: The Canon of the Locked Fold
summary: A canon that fuses sealing with space and with metal to lock a fold of the field shut and to close an iron seal.
